content_of_post_to_comment: Uncommon advice: If you don't know what to pursue in life right now, pursue yourself. Pursue becoming the healthiest, happiest, most healed, most present, most confident version of yourself. Then the right path will reveal itself.
comment: The tricky part is that “pursue yourself” can become endless self-improvement. At some point, growth also comes from committing to something imperfect and letting the path shape you.
